preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 30, inclusive.
The length of the permutation is between 1 and 30000, inclusive.
The maximum cost of the operation is between 1 and 4, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 30000, inclusive.
Each element in the permutation is between 1 and n, inclusive.
All elements in the permutation are unique.
The first parameter of each query is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The second parameter of each query is between 1 and 10^18, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output_i_j is either an integer from 1 to n or -1
postconditions.description: The output for each query is either a valid permutation number or -1 if the permutation does not exist.
